name: Seeed Studio XIAO RA4M1
description: Renesas RA4M1 (the Arduino UNO R4 MCU, 48 MHz Cortex-M4F) in the XIAO footprint with 14-bit ADC, 12-bit DAC, CAN controller and battery charging.
notes: 256 KB flash / 32 KB SRAM / 8 KB EEPROM; the CAN controller needs an external transceiver (none on board).
19 GPIO = 11 side pads + 8 back pads (D11-D18); 3.3 V I/O, unlike the 5 V UNO R4.
No Wi-Fi/BLE on this MCU; deep-sleep draw about 45 uA.
Standard 14-pad XIAO footprint (7 per side, 2.54 mm pitch, 15.24 mm row spacing); header coordinates assume the pads are centred on the 21 mm board length.
